_context.detail.stillLoading: Tooltip of the disabled Edit button while the file is loading.
_context.actions.truncated: Badge: only the beginning of a large file is shown.
_context.editor.unsaved: Badge in the file editor when the draft has changes not saved yet.
_context.editor.conflictTitle: {name} is a file name. The Box is the AI coworker's machine where the file lives.
_context.editor.keepTheirs: Button: keep the version someone else saved, drop my edits.
_context.publish.unshare: Verb: stop sharing the file through its public link.
_context.empty.title: Title shown when a folder holds no file.
_context.list.type: Column header: the kind of file (its extension, or Folder).
_context.list.folder: Value of the Type column for a folder.
_context.list.file: Value of the Type column for a file without extension.
_context.grid.published: Accessible label of a globe icon on a file that has a public link.
_context.uploadOutcome.someFailed: Toast after a batch upload. {failed} files failed out of {total}.
_context.uploadOutcome.oversized: Toast when files are refused before uploading. {names} is one or two file names joined by a comma, {more} how many more files were refused beyond those, {count} the total refused, {limit} the size limit in MB.
_context.detail.editTruncated: Tooltip of the disabled Edit button. {limit} is a formatted number of characters.
_context.uploadOutcome.machineUnreachable: Upload error. {name} is the file name; the machine is the server running the workspace's coworkers.

detail.editNotText: Only text files can be edited here.
detail.editTruncated: This file is over {limit} characters and cannot be edited here. Download it, or ask the coworker to edit it.
detail.editBinary: This file is not text, so editing it here would corrupt it.

delete.title: Delete {name}?
delete.file: The file is deleted from the box. This cannot be undone.
delete.folder: The folder and everything inside it are deleted from the box. This cannot be undone.

editor.conflictDescription: Someone, or a coworker, wrote to this file after you opened it. Saving now replaces their version with yours.
editor.discardDescription: Your edits to {name} are not saved yet. Closing the editor throws them away.

preview.noPreview: No preview available for this file type
preview.readFailed: This file could not be read

publish.unpublishDescription: The link stops working right away, for everyone who has it.
publish.unshareDescription: The public link stops working right away. Anyone holding it gets a 404.

list.dropHere: Drop files or folders to upload here
list.name: Name
list.empty: Nothing here yet. Anything a coworker downloads, creates or edits for the whole workspace lands in this folder, and so does what you drop on this page.

uploadOutcome.someFailed: {failed} of {total, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} failed to upload
uploadOutcome.uploaded: {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} uploaded
uploadOutcome.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Reload the page and try again.
uploadOutcome.tooLarge: This file is too large to upload.
uploadOutcome.retryLater: Upload failed. Retry in a moment.
uploadOutcome.networkFailed: Upload failed. Check your connection and retry.
uploadOutcome.oversized: {names}{more, plural, =0 {} one { and # more} other { and # more}} {count, plural, one {is} other {are}} over the {limit} MB limit.
uploadOutcome.machineUpdating: The machine of this workspace was updating. Retry the upload.
uploadOutcome.engineUpdateNeeded: This workspace runs on a machine that needs an engine update to accept files over {limit} MB. It updates itself, so try again in a few minutes.
uploadOutcome.machineUnreachable: Could not upload {name}. Your machine may be unreachable.
